policy.projection: Tool-call fields are extracted without assistant thinking or provider metadata. For game results, output is the parsed tool text, verified equal to original details. For coding results, content text and details are retained. Formatting changes only apart from declared tokens.

policy.omitted: All thinking, message/signature/provider IDs, session/task metadata and unrelated coding results. omittedCalls lists the excluded calls; this is not a complete raw session or a fresh model run.

entries.text:
Fixed `components/platform/platform.gd` by duplicating the Area2D collision shape before resizing it, preventing platform instances from sharing dimensions.

Validated by launching the main scene and confirming runtime trigger widths match platform widths: 256, 128, 384, and 768 px.
